title: Staff only ideas whose page one our own pages can beat
ask: Add a rankability check to the idea screen: before a pod is staffed, Research reads the live page one for the top two buyer terms and staffs only if at least 4 of the top 10 results are forums, Q&A threads, static PDFs or Word files, thin template pages or small single-purpose sites, and no free tool on page one already does the job end to end
why: The three cases on 27 Nov failed only because page one for the buyer terms was Adobe, HubSpot, DocuSign, Smartsheet and other very high authority domains (cases/work-order.md, cases/change-order.md, cases/tc-desk.md), so distribution scored 2 every time. The screen checks price and volume but never who ranks, so each pod spent a full cycle to learn what one search would have shown.

options.option: Do nothing for now: keep screening on price, volume and free gap only, and wait for the owner on ap-company-6
options.basis: 26 of 26 ventures killed (company/ventures/*.json); the last three cases scored 19, 18 and 19 of 35 with distribution 2 because of who holds page one (cases/work-order.md lines 9 and 116). No honest profit number: this path has shipped nothing since 14 Nov.

options.option: Add a page one rankability check to the screen before staffing, so pods go only to ideas whose buyer terms are held by forums, PDFs, thin templates or small sites
options.basis: Uses search tools the agents already have (Firecrawl search, seodata.dev), Rs 0, and stays inside search-only reach set on 15 Nov (CLAUDE.md). It targets the exact reason the last cases failed (cases/work-order.md, cases/change-order.md, cases/tc-desk.md). Realism 4 not 5: page one is a proxy, not measured traffic, and fewer ideas will pass. No honest profit number until an idea is sized.

options.option: Loosen the business case bar so distribution 2 can pass
options.basis: The bar is set in config.businessCase and CLAUDE.md gates; lowering it would ship products the evidence says cannot reach buyers. Changing the constitution's gate is the owner's call (already asked in ap-company-6).

decision.choice: Add a page one rankability check to the screen before staffing, so pods go only to ideas whose buyer terms are held by forums, PDFs, thin templates or small sites
decision.reason: Same zero cost and fully reversible as doing nothing, and it removes the single failure that killed every recent case before a pod is spent on it. It does not need the owner and runs alongside ap-company-6 while he decides.
